faqs.question: How do we reach the lodge from Hawassa or Addis Ababa?
faqs.answer: We are 30 minutes from Hawassa Airport on paved roads, and we can arrange private car pickup for guests arriving from Hawassa or Addis.

faqs.question: Are guided forest walks suitable for families and beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer gentle 1-hour garden trails as well as longer hillside walks matched to your pace.

faqs.question: Do rooms have hot water and reliable electricity?
faqs.answer: Yes. All cabins and villas feature solar-heated showers, backup power, and mosquito-screened balconies.

faqs.question: Can we book meals and coffee tours at the lodge?
faqs.answer: Yes, daily breakfast is included with every cabin, and dinner and Sidama coffee tours can be reserved at check-in.

newsPosts.title: New River-View Cabins Completed
newsPosts.excerpt: Wake up beside clear forest streams with private wooden balconies.
newsPosts.body:
Three newly built forest cabins overlooking our clear hillside stream are now ready for weekend bookings.

Each cabin uses locally sourced timber and offers wide open views into the forest canopy.
newsPosts.author: Selam Tadesse

newsPosts.title: Weekly Sidama Coffee Farm Walks Added
newsPosts.excerpt: Meet local growers and enjoy fresh coffee brewed under shade trees.
newsPosts.body:
Guests staying two nights or more can now join our morning visit to nearby family coffee gardens.

You will see how cherries are picked, dried, and roasted right before tasting.
newsPosts.author: Guest Relations

newsPosts.title: Hawassa Airport Shuttle Runs Daily
newsPosts.excerpt: Short 30-minute ride straight from arrivals into quiet forest air.
newsPosts.body:
Let us know your Hawassa arrival time and our driver will welcome you with cold spring water and direct lodge transport.

Group vans are also available for weekend retreats.
newsPosts.author: Lodge Team

blogPosts.title: Why Wondo Genet Is Ethiopia's Favorite Forest Escape
blogPosts.excerpt: Natural hillside springs, shady fruit trees, and birdsong just past Hawassa.
blogPosts.body:
Just thirty minutes east of Hawassa sits green hill country lined with natural mineral springs and tall fig trees.

Families and weekend travelers come from Addis Ababa to slow down, enjoy clean air, and walk peaceful trails without long drives.
blogPosts.author: Desta Lemma

blogPosts.title: From Cherry to Cup: Visiting a Sidama Coffee Farm
blogPosts.excerpt: See how washed Sidama Arabica coffee is grown under tall shade trees nearby.
blogPosts.body:
Sidama coffee is known around the world for bright, sweet citrus and floral notes.

During our morning farm walk, local growers welcome guests to taste ripe coffee cherries and roast fresh beans over an open clay pan.
blogPosts.author: Hanna Tadesse

blogPosts.title: Spotlighting Colobus Monkeys & Forest Birds at Dawn
blogPosts.excerpt: What to look and listen for along our shaded riverside morning paths.
blogPosts.body:
The hour right after sunrise brings out black-and-white colobus monkeys along the upper branches above our cabins.

Grab a pair of binoculars at reception and follow our guide along the stream with zero steep climbs.
blogPosts.author: Elias Bekele
